final: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) as male_inpatient, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) as male_outpatient, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) as ratio_percentage FROM Patient
